meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能替你操作浏览器,比如打开网址、点击、填表等,还会保持页面状态,分步完成复杂任务,也可以连上你正在用的 Chrome。
howto.when: 当用户提出任何浏览器操作请求时触发,比如打开网页、点击、填表。

say.text: 打开 example.com,然后截图给我。
say.note: 会新建页面并截图保存。

say.text: 帮我在搜索框输入“天气”并点击搜索。
say.note: 会定位输入框和按钮并操作。

say.text: 提取这个页面上的所有商品价格。
say.note: 会读取网页内容并返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate the browser on your behalf: navigate, click, fill forms, and more. It preserves page state between steps, completes complex tasks incrementally, and can either launch a new Chromium or connect to your existing Chrome.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user makes any browser interaction request, such as opening a page, clicking, or filling a form.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Creates a page and saves a screenshot.

say_en.text: Type "weather" in the search box and click search.
say_en.note: Locates the input and button, then acts.

say_en.text: Extract all product prices from this page.
say_en.note: Reads the page content and returns results.
